title: ukpga_20160002_en.pdf — section 46
text:
(7) A person against whom a prohibition order or a premises order has been made
may appeal against a variation of the order under section 29 as if the varied
order were a sentence passed on the person for the offence referred to in section
29(1) (to the extent it would not otherwise be so appealable).
